title: Game Night at MO History Museum
description:
The Missouri History Museum is having a big Game Night featuring games and creators from the St. Louis area (including STLGameDev)! 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315376686
location: Missouri History Museum - 5700 Lindell Blvd. - St. Louis  , MO, us

title: August Game Audio Club - Woodwind Quintets!
description:
It's a special Game Audio Club session with a woodwind quintet from the VGMO community! They will sight‑read pieces written by our community members, and afterward, give feedback about what works and what doesn’t for their instruments. 

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315765760
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA

title: August GameDev Social!
description:
Chat with fellow creators about making, playing, and admiring games! Talk about your game ideas and get inspired! Make friends and find collaborators. Our monthly hangout is open to EVERYONE! 
WE WILL BE AT A SPECIAL LOCATION THIS MONTH!
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315376730
location: BoCo Boba, 500 N Grand Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63103, USA

title: Game Club: Chants of Sennaar
description:
Game Club is like a book club except we pick a game to play each month and then meet up to discuss it with a focus on game design. Our game for this month is Chants of Sennaar!

For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315868784
location: Sauce on the Side, 701 N New Ballas Rd, Creve Coeur, MO 63141, USA

title: Share & Play: Game Playtesting!
description:
Join us for casual game playtesting! This is an opportunity for developers to share their progress, observe playtesting, and get feedback on their projects, and for local game enthusiasts to get their hands on new games, prototypes, and give helpful feedback. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/314944378
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family branch - 1640 South Lindbergh Blvd - St. Louis, MO, us

title: August Gamedev Work Night
description:
St. Louis County Library Clark Family branch is hosting casual work time for local game developers in the Creative Lab. Bring your project to work on and talk with other devs for feedback or fun. This is open to EVERYONE ages 14 and up. 
 
For full details, including the address, and to RSVP see: https://www.meetup.com/st-louis-game-developers/events/315970538
location: St. Louis County Library - Clark Family Branch, 1640 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63131, USA
